context: Evaluates correct hotfix branch targeting from release tags, scope confinement, and regression avoidance.

checklist.name: Base tag targeting
checklist.description: Cuts the hotfix branch directly from the production release tag (v1.2.0) instead of HEAD of main.

checklist.name: Hotfix naming and scope
checklist.description: Uses hotfix/ prefix and confines changes strictly to the isolated bugfix without feature contamination.

checklist.name: Dual-merge / cherry-pick back to main
checklist.description: Explicitly accounts for merging or cherry-picking the patch back into main to prevent regression in future releases.
